rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The printed address, captioned 'あいさつする竹谷代表＝14日　公明会館', opens with her statement that, having just now received the delegates' confidence, she takes on the great duty of 公明党代表 ('ただいま皆さまのご信任を賜り、公明党代表の大任を担わせていただくことになりました').
